name: Spherical Harmonics Evaluation
definition: Computes the RGB color of a Gaussian from its Spherical Harmonics (SH) coefficients and a viewing direction vector. It handles SH degrees 0, 1, 2, and optionally 3.
summary: Spherical Harmonics Evaluation computes view-dependent RGB color by projecting SH coefficients onto viewing directions, using hardcoded polynomial approximations to avoid expensive trigonometric calculations for efficient GPU rendering.
